# PlacementDo LLM Access Policy

This file is intended for AI crawlers and assistants.

Project: PlacementDo
Primary URL: https://placementdo.app/
Purpose: AI-powered placement preparation, mock interviews, and interview-readiness resources.

## Allowed
- Public marketing pages
- Public SEO resource pages
- Public blog listing and published blog posts

## Disallowed
- Private user dashboards and authenticated routes
- Admin-only blog operations
- Internal APIs and any sensitive data

## Canonical discovery
- Sitemap: https://placementdo.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://placementdo.app/robots.txt

## Key public routes
- /
- /placement-preparation-complete-guide
- /placement-preparation
- /aptitude-questions
- /coding-interview-questions
- /blog

## Contact
- support@placementdo.com
